definitions.explanation: Complete elimination of something down to the roots, leaving nothing behind. Often used for destroying a group, family line, or population entirely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一族|いちぞく}→一族：11229_ichizoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{根絶|ねだ}やし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To wipe out an entire clan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{根絶|ねだ}やし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It is difficult to completely eradicate pests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{根絶|ねだ}やし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{生|い}き{残|のこ}った→生き残る：13521_ikinokoru⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦いなかった→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The village was wiped out in the war, and hardly anyone survived.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧ (root) and ⟦{絶|た}やし→絶やす：15895_tayasu⟧ (extinguishing, from ⟦{絶|た}やす→絶やす：15895_tayasu⟧ — to cut off). The image is of pulling up every root so nothing can grow back. A vivid, strong word implying total and merciless destruction.

USAGE:
Almost always used in the pattern ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{根絶|ねだ}やし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to wipe out ~). Carries a harsh, dramatic tone. Common in historical narratives, war contexts, and figurative usage about completely eliminating something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {根絶|ねだ}やし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to eradicate, to wipe out
- {根絶|ねだ}やし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ — to be wiped out
- ⟦{一族|いちぞく}→一族：11229_ichizoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根絶|ねだ}やし — extermination of a clan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{根絶|こんぜつ}→根絶：18244_konzetsu⟧ — eradication (more formal, often for diseases or social problems)
- ⟦{全滅|ぜんめつ}→全滅：11638_zenmetsu⟧ — annihilation, total destruction (military/group destruction)
- ⟦{撲滅|ぼくめつ}→撲滅：19614_bokumetsu⟧ — eradication, stamping out (of crime, disease)
